tool_schemas.name: search_google_scholar_key_words
tool_schemas.description: Runs a keyword search against Google Scholar–style indexing and returns up to `num_results` publication results for `query`, while recording the request and the returned result set for later retrieval/analytics (this endpoint is not paged; increase `num_results` to retrieve more). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `query` is empty/invalid or `num_results` is not a positive integer, and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when request/rate limits are reached. Raises `UPSTREAM_ERROR` when the Scholar provider cannot be reached or returns an unusable response.

tool_schemas.name: search_google_scholar_advanced
tool_schemas.description: Executes an advanced Scholar search for `query` with optional `author` and `year_range` filters and returns up to `num_results` publication results, persisting the query and response for reuse/analytics (this endpoint is not paged; increase `num_results` to retrieve more). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `query` is empty/invalid, `num_results` is not a positive integer, or `year_range` is not a valid range (e.g., wrong types or start year greater than end year). Raises `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when request/rate limits are exceeded and `UPSTREAM_ERROR` when the upstream Scholar source fails or returns an invalid payload.

tool_schemas.name: get_author_info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches an author profile for `author_name` and returns the resolved author information, caching/refreshing the stored profile to support reuse and rate-limiting. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `author_name` is empty/invalid and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when profile lookups exceed configured rate limits. Raises `NOT_FOUND` when no matching author profile can be resolved and `UPSTREAM_ERROR` when the upstream provider is unavailable or returns an invalid response.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling API key identity and entitlement snapshot, including key status, configured per-minute/per-day limits, and current request counters. Refuses with `UNAUTHORIZED` when no/invalid credentials are presented and `FORBIDDEN` when the key is not usable for this operation.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (used for authentication and quota enforcement).

tool_schemas.name: list_scholar_searches
tool_schemas.description: Lists previously recorded Scholar searches for the calling API key, newest-first, with optional filtering by status and search_type. Returns a paged list and refuses with `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when the API key is invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

query_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the stored query.

created_after.description: Only return searches created strictly after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return searches created strictly before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response; when provided, other paging params are applied after the cursor position.

tool_schemas.name: get_scholar_search
tool_schemas.description: Fetches one recorded Scholar search by id for the calling API key, including its execution metadata and terminal/error fields when present. Refuses with `NOT_FOUND` if the id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller) and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when credentials are invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

search_id.description: Primary key of the scholar_searches row to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted publication results for a recorded search, ordered by rank ascending. Returns a paged list of result rows with embedded publication fields and refuses with `NOT_FOUND` if the search is unknown/inaccessible or `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when credentials are invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

search_id.description: Primary key of the scholar_searches row whose results should be returned.

include_raw_result.description: When true, includes the stored raw_result payload for each row; when false, omits it to reduce response size.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_scholar_search
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel an in-flight search by transitioning its status to `cancelled` (allowed only from `queued` or `running`). On success, sets `completed_at`, clears any pending result materialization, and returns the updated search record. Refuses with `CONFLICT` when the search is already terminal (`succeeded`/`failed`/`cancelled`), `NOT_FOUND` when inaccessible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when credentials are invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

search_id.description: Primary key of the scholar_searches row to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to record for diagnostics.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_key_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the calling API key between lifecycle states (`active` ↔ `suspended`, or to `revoked`). This is intended for self-serve key control (e.g., pause a compromised key); once `revoked`, it cannot be reactivated. Returns the updated API key record and refuses with `CONFLICT` on invalid transitions and `UNAUTHORIZED` when credentials are invalid.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (the key being updated).

status.description: Target lifecycle status. Valid transitions: active→suspended|revoked; suspended→active|revoked; revoked→(none).
